## Description (from file header)

ThreadClassGateHook — LATHE-PRO-MS4a Forge-Triple hook.Safety gate: validates that the manufactured pitch diameter of asingle-point-threaded part lies within the ISO 965-1 (metric) orASME B1.1 (UN) tolerance class band. Blocks the threading cascadewhen the projected pitch diameter escapes the class window.Triggers on dispatcher actions:  • turning_thread_optimize       (capstone)  • turning_thread_stochastic_plan  • turning_thread_robust_optimizer  • turning_thread_robust_pass_countDec
